products.title: Bread & Fred - Limited Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Climb to the summit in Bread & Fred, the charming yet brutally challenging co-op platformer from Atari. Available as an exclusive physical edition, this release lets you experience the complete adventure as two rope-tied penguins whose only chance of reaching the top is perfect teamwork or incredible solo skill.

Meet Bread and Fred, two determined penguins with one ambitious goal: conquer a towering snowy mountain. Tied together by a rope, every jump, swing, and climb requires careful coordination. One mistimed move can send both of you tumbling back down the mountain, turning every successful ascent into a hard-earned victory.

Master the unique physics-based climbing mechanics by using momentum to swing across impossible gaps, anchoring your partner during risky jumps, and grabbing onto walls just long enough to reach the next platform. Whether you're laughing through spectacular failures with a friend or taking on the challenge alone with Jeff the Rock as your trusty climbing partner, every attempt brings you one step closer to the summit.

Once you've mastered the climb, test your skills in Speedrun Mode or dive into the massive Laboratory Update, featuring an entirely new area filled with fresh mechanics, new challenges, and plenty of hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.

The mountain is unforgiving, but reaching the top has never been so rewarding.

Key Features

  • Challenging co-op platforming for two players with unique rope-based gameplay
  • Play solo by teaming up with Jeff the Rock
  • Swing, climb, and master precise physics-based movement
  • Conquer a massive snowy mountain packed with challenging obstacles
  • Compete for the fastest times in dedicated Speedrun Mode
  • Includes the complete Laboratory Update with a new map, mechanics, challenges, and hidden secrets
  • Cute penguins, hilarious failures, and endless replayability

products.title: Apidya' Special - Limited Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
A Home Computer Legend Returns

Originally released in 1992, Apidya became one of the most celebrated shoot ’em ups of its era thanks to its stunning visuals, unique insect-themed world, and unforgettable soundtrack. Now, Apidya' Special brings the classic back as a faithful 24-bit pixel remake, rebuilt from the ground up while staying true to the original experience.

Developed together with members of the original team and a devoted longtime fan turned developer, Apidya' Special combines original assets with all-new pixel art, additional sound effects, and exclusive music enhancements.

Featuring New Music by Chris Hülsbeck

Legendary composer Chris Hülsbeck returns with brand-new studio recordings of the iconic soundtrack, available alongside the original music that helped define the game.

Classic or Modern Presentation

Experience Apidya' Special in enhanced widescreen with new parallax effects or instantly switch to the original 4:3 presentation for an authentic 1992 experience. Optional CRT effects, including scanlines, shadow masks, and phosphor bloom, recreate the look and feel of classic displays.

Key Features

  • Authentic 24-bit pixel remake built from scratch

  • Developed with members of the original Apidya team

  • Exclusive new studio soundtrack recordings by Chris Hülsbeck

  • Switch between HD widescreen and classic 4:3 modes

  • Optional CRT effects for authentic retro visuals

  • Five unique worlds with hidden stages and secrets

  • Twenty challenging boss encounters

  • Randomized gameplay events, including Night Mode variations

  • Local co-op mode with helper drone support

  • Modern accessibility and difficulty options

products.title: Tavern Talk Complete Edition - Deluxe Edition (No Game)
products.body_html:
Discover the cozy fantasy world of Tavern Talk Complete Edition, the first-ever physical Nintendo Switch release of the beloved visual novel adventure. This Deluxe Edition does not include a game but does contain all other items from the Deluxe Edition.

Deluxe Edition

  • Deluxe Edition Box (serialized)
  • Lorebook (approx. 88 pages)
  • Original Soundtrack
  • Dice Scroll (approx. 25.5 x 5 x 5cm)
  • Sticker Sheet
  • A3 Poster

Inspired by Coffee Talk, VA-11 HALL-A, and classic tabletop RPG adventures, Tavern Talk places you behind the counter of the Wayfarer’s Inn, a lively tavern in the fantasy land of Asteria. As the innkeeper, you will listen to adventurers’ stories, gather rumors, create quests, and serve magical drinks that can influence your patrons’ destinies.

Meet a colorful cast of characters inspired by Pen & Paper adventures, build meaningful relationships, and uncover the mystery of an ancient evil threatening the land. Every conversation, choice, and potion you brew helps shape both the lives of your guests and the future of Asteria itself.

Beyond its heartfelt storytelling and charming atmosphere, Tavern Talk also allows you to customize the Wayfarer’s Inn with trinkets and decorations brought back by returning adventurers, turning your tavern into a true home for weary travelers.

products.title: BloodRayne: Definitive Collection - Deluxe Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Exclusive worldwide Nintendo Switch Deluxe Edition from Strictly Limited, bringing the cult classic sensation to collectors in its ultimate physical form!

The BloodRayne: Definitive Edition unites all three iconic entries in the series in one complete, enhanced collection, bringing the legendary dhampir back with updated visuals and modern improvements.

Deluxe Edition

  • Premium Deluxe Edition Box
  • Nintendo Switch Limited Edition
  • The original Soundtrack on CD
  • Artbook with concept art, character designs, environments and behind the scenes insights, softcover 170 mm × 135 mm, approx. 80 pages
  • Two-sided poster featuring original artwork of BloodRayne and BloodRayne 2
  • Die-cut character sticker

Become Rayne, a half-human, half-vampire agent working for the Brimstone Society, as she hunts supernatural threats across a dark and violent world. From battling occult forces tied to the Third Reich to confronting her own vampiric bloodline, Rayne’s journey spans brutal conflicts, relentless enemies, and deeply personal vendettas.

This collection includes the original BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal – Fresh Bites, combining fast-paced third-person action with stylish 2D hack-and-slash gameplay. Face hordes of soldiers, grotesque creatures, and powerful bosses using Rayne’s acrobatic combat skills, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric abilities.

Enhanced for modern platforms, this definitive edition delivers the ultimate way to experience the full BloodRayne saga — a cult classic series known for its unique blend of action, horror, and gothic style.

Features

  • Complete Trilogy Included – Experience all three games: BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal – Fresh Bites in one definitive collection.

  • Enhanced for Modern Platforms – Updated visuals and performance improvements optimized for today’s systems.

  • Iconic Dhampir Protagonist – Play as Rayne, the half vampire, half human agent of the Brimstone Society.

  • Fast Paced Hack and Slash Combat – Combine acrobatic gunplay, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric powers in stylish action battles.

  • Dark Gothic Storyline – Battle occult forces, supernatural horrors, and vampiric enemies across a globe spanning narrative.

products.title: R-Type Dimensions III - Special Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Special Edition Contents

This Special Limited Edition offers additional insights to R-Type III.

Physical Game + Printed Manual (Full Color)

Officially licensed Nintendo Switch game with a reversible cover.
Includes a beautiful retro-inspired printed manual filled with controls, lore, ship systems, Force breakdowns, stage briefs & tips.

Art Booklet

A high-quality soft cover book giving insights to:

  • Concept art to guide the visual journey of the remake

  • Behind-the-scenes designs 

  • Further information on ship with weapons, but also enemies and level designs

  • More insights with comments from developer and some references to early R-Type III marketing from the 90's

Original Soundtrack on CD

  • Newly rearranged orchestration & synth remixes created for R-Type Dimensions III

 

The legendary side-scrolling shoot ’em up returns — bigger, bolder, and far more dangerous than ever before on Nintendo Switch.

R-Type Dimensions III is a full-scale reimagining of R-Type III: The Third Lightning, Irem’s cult 1993 console-exclusive masterpiece. Every infamous stage, every grotesque Bydo monstrosity, every cruel trap and rotating biomechanical nightmare has been rebuilt with modern 3D graphics, a rearranged soundtrack, and an arsenal of new features. Yet beneath the new polish beats the same sadistic heart of the SNES classic.

Fans of the original will feel right at home — and completely terrified.

As the pilot of the cutting-edge R-90 “Ragnarok”, you embark on the Third Bydo Mission armed with Wave Cannons, Bits, and one of the most defining mechanics in shmup history: the Force unit. The original R-Type III was the first in the series to introduce multiple Force types (Round, Shadow, and Cyclone), each radically altering how the game is played. These return here in stunning detail, with effects and animations faithful to their 16-bit personalities.

Now, more than 30 years later, you can experience this classic in two completely different dimensions — instantly.

With the push of a button, swap between authentic pixel-perfect 2D visuals and fully reimagined 3D graphics, complete with dynamic lighting, modern effects, animated environments, and cinematic camera flourishes.
No loading. No interruption. Just pure dimensional shift.

For hardcore fans, this remake includes nods to the original SNES secrets, visual homages to Tamtex’s clever Mode 7 trickery, reinterpreted boss-entry animations, and environmental details inspired by Japanese design notes and old developer commentary. (Yes, that infamous Stage 2 censorship oddity? It’s referenced in a clever way. Yes, the lava labyrinth in Stage 4 is still agonizing. No, the Force pod still won’t protect you from everything.)

Prepare to face the Bydo as you’ve never seen them before — or exactly as you remember them.

Either way, you’re going to die. A lot.

New Features in R-Type Dimensions III

Advanced Mode – A New Level of Pain
The entire campaign re-engineered for maximum brutality.

  • Faster enemy movement

  • Denser projectile patterns

  • Remixed waves and boss variants
    It’s the closest thing to a modern arcade “Ultra Mode”

2-Player Local Co-op – Bring a Wingman
Coordinate your Forces, stagger your Wave Cannon charges, and relive the golden age of cooperative shmups — all from your couch.

Instant 2D/3D Switch – Reality Is Optional
Tap once to switch between:

  • Classic SNES-style pixel art, meticulously recreated

  • Dynamic 3D visuals with modern shaders, effects, and animated backgrounds
    Swap on the fly — even mid-boss — for an experience that feels both nostalgic and cutting-edge.

Multiple Difficulty Levels – For Trainees and Masochists Alike
From introductory settings for newcomers to brutal Expert Mode, every pilot can find their (un)comfort zone.

Online Leaderboards – Climb the Dimensional Ladder
Take your place among global R-Type aces.
Score-chasing returns with modern tracking and bragging rights.

products.title: Trouble Witches Final: Episode 1 - Daughters of Amalgam - Special Edition (PlayStation 4)
products.body_html:
The Ultimate Cute ’Em Up Bullet-Hell Experience for PlayStation 4

The beloved witch-themed shoot ’em up returns in its most complete form. Originally released in 2007 by the developer behind Cotton Reboot!, Trouble Witches FINAL! Episode 1 - Daughters of Amalgam has been continuously refined for over a decade, culminating in this definitive edition. Featuring upgraded visuals, expanded content, and multiple game modes, this is the ultimate evolution of the cult classic Cute ’Em Up.

The Special Edition includes:

Special Edition Box
A custom-designed collector’s box that protects and presents the contents elegantly, ideal for display with any curated game collection.

Cute Witches DLC (with Cotton included exclusively in Special Edition)
Includes all content plus access to all twelve character routes and abilities. Experiment with unique witches, attack styles, and familiars for varied tactical play.

History Artbook
A premium artbook packed with concept artwork, early designs, development materials, and creator insights—offering a comprehensive look behind the scenes of the series and its evolution.

Original Soundtrack
A complete audio collection of the game’s music, featuring thematic compositions that capture the magical, high-energy atmosphere of the Trouble Witches world.

Choose from twelve witches, each with unique magic, familiars, and playstyles, and fly through six dazzling stages filled with intense danmaku action. With fully voiced Japanese dialogue and enhanced English subtitles, every playthrough offers its own charm and personality. Whether you seek high-score perfection, arcade authenticity, or a lighthearted magical adventure, Trouble Witches FINAL! delivers depth, variety, and endless replayability.

Character Spotlights

Cynfi Porat
The gentle and dreamy queen of Fairyland in Eihemland. Calm and conflict-averse, Cynfi prefers quiet days of rest and fantasy, yet her optimism always shines through.

Louis Leondyke
A hardworking witch and street hawker from the western sector of the eastern country. Burdened by family debt, she pursues profit with sharp insight—though beneath her business focus lies a sincere and compassionate heart.

Yoko Redster
A spirited high school student who dreams of entering the magical academy Ryufuyabelc. With her parents opposed, she yearns for something remarkable to change her life.

Conon Mildiazzhe Krakow

products.title: Simon the Sorcerer Origins Special Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Simon the Sorcerer Origins – The Official Prequel

Experience the Magical World like never before in Simon the Sorcerer Origins, the highly anticipated prequel to the cult classic Point-and-Click adventure series.
In this new adventure, Simon, the most sarcastic wizard in video game history, returns to reveal secrets and stories from his past!

Special Edition
Show off your love for Simon the Sorcerer Origins with this beautifully designed retro-style collector’s box. Made from premium materials and featuring exclusive artwork, it’s a must-have for every fan of the series.

  • Limited Edition
    Physical copy of the game officially licensed for Nintendo Switch, including a full-color printed manual.
  • Stunning History Artbook
    Dive behind the scenes with the official artbook, filled with concept art, character sketches, and design notes that bring Simon’s world to life. A true treasure for collectors and adventure game enthusiasts.
  • Epic Original Soundtrack
    Experience the magical soundtrack that defines Simon’s latest journey. From whimsical tunes to dramatic orchestral themes, every track captures the heart and humor of the adventure—perfect for listening long after the game ends.

 

Puzzles, Magic & Classic Simon Humor
Whether you're visiting the Magical World for the first time or returning once again - Simon is back, along with his unique sense of humor and a completely new graphic style. Simon the Sorcerer Origins brings the charm of the original saga back in a completely hand-drawn graphic style, blending classic gameplay mechanics with a fresh, new world of magic.

Your Adventure, Your Puzzles
Solve loads of tricky puzzles, test your wits, and face a variety of absurd situations and quirky characters. Combine items and clues to unravel the big mystery and become the legendary wizard you were always meant to be.

Featuring the Original Voice of Simon
Enjoy Simon's legendary sarcastic remarks once again with the voice of the original voice actor, Chris Barrie (English) / Erik Borner (German), who brought the character to life with humor in parts I and II.

A New Magical Journey Begins
Thirty years after his first appearance on the screen, Simon is drawn into a foreign world by an ancient pro-phecy, that will tell his origins. This world is populated by powerful yet mostly useless wizards and strange creatures. On his journey, Simon must solve a series of tricky puzzles, operate alchemical devices, and learn powerful spells. And yes, he also has to taste a few disgusting stews!

products.title: X-Out: Resurfaced - Special Limited Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
X-OUT: RESURFACED - BACK FROM THE DEPTHS AND BETTER THAN EVER!

Get ready to relive the thrill of an arcade classic reimagined for modern gamers and audiences, who played the original back in the days! X-Out: Resurfaced brings the legendary underwater shoot-'em-up into the 21st century, blending nostalgic gameplay with stunning visual and audio upgrades.

MODERNIZED GRAPHICS
Explore vibrant aquatic environments with deadly turret towers and mechanical sea creatures visually upgraded to high-definition and with effects never seen before in the original game.

  • EXTENDED SOUNDTRACK BY CHRIS HUELSBECK
    Immerse yourself with music by the legendary composer, blending retro themes with modern audio design combining synth electronic and orchestral sounds. You can choose between the new OST or the original C64 and Amiga tunes.

    With preconfigured load-outs, item descriptions and improved better usability to upgrade four different types of submarines for your powerful fleet.

    Blast and dive through 8 varied stages deep beneath the surface, fight tons of deadly enemies and face epic bosses.

    Team up for the very first time to face the alien menace. Combine your skills, strategize, and experien-ce thrilling action together in this exciting cooperative mode designed for ultimate teamwork!

SPECIAL EDITION
The exclusive X-Out Resurfaced Special Edition Box stands out with its elegant design, providing space for the game, artbook, and soundtrack-an iconic collectible for true fans. The dimensions are 155x37x218mm.

    Dive into the captivating world of X-Out: Resurfaced with this exclusive artbook! Featuring stunning concept art and developer insights, it unveils the creative process and rich lore of the game. A must-have for fans and art enthusiasts! It's presented in A5 format (148 x 210 mm) with 76 pages.

    The soundtrack combines classic and new tracks composed by Chris Hülsbeck. The perfect mix of retro synthesizers and modern sounds brings the atmosphere of the game straight to your ears.

products.title: Dezatopia & Mecha Ritz Limited Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Dezatopia & Mecha Ritz Limited Edition, officially licensed Nintendo Switch game. Includes a colorful game manual. 

Strictly Limited Games exclusive. Limited to 1,500 copies worldwide. All of our games are individually numbered. We ship internationally.

From the talented indie dev at HEY and with the help of the awesome people at Hanaji Games comes the 1-2 punch combo of Shoot 'Em Up action, Dezatopia & Mecha Ritz, in one awesome collection!

Dezatopia

Strange and unusual creatures inhabited Earth’s underground, beyond the reach of sunlight and human eyes. This was until Momoko, a fashion-obsessed high school girl, accidentally discovered them. Together, they plotted to combine the civilizations above and below the surface to create a new world: Dezatopia.

Akane and Aoba, two of Momoko’s schoolmates, were hired to help start construction of the towering subterranean bridge. However, on the verge of completion, they discovered the extent of her plans and decided to sabotage the operation. Their only hope of repelling the waves of beasts loyal to their human queen is their work ship, the Speleological Fighter Pink Aurora.

An expansive, detailed world filled with intense thrills and colorful characters await you. Feel it for yourself - anytime and anywhere.


List of Features:

  • Classic arcade style: Straightforward game system with the thrill of dodging bullets and destroying foes, a must for any SHMUP.
  • Huge volume of content: 24 unique stages with 21 bosses arranged in 21 routes.
  • Intuitive controls: New yet simple controls which can be picked up by novices and veterans alike.
  • Unique shop system: Purchase items on the fly in a feature new to SHMUPS.
  • Dynamic rank system: 1000 steps of difficulty that automatically adjusts to suit the player’s skill.
  • Amusing story: High school students and underground creatures clash against the combination and domination of two worlds.
  • Unlockable bonuses: Find hidden items in each stage to open up music in the sound test, background stories, and more.
  • Graphics: Colorful, eye-catching pixel art with smooth animation.
  • Soundtrack: All-new music by HEY completely with FM synthesis totaling over 40 tracks.


Mecha Ritz: Steel Rondo

Set in a mechanized world, the story begins with a world-renowned young scientist named Veloce. One day she invented "Mecha" and eradicated humankind with her creation, recreating a metallic world filled with Mechas. Pilot humanity's last hope, a Mecha imbued with human will, through the onslaught of enemy waves. Yet as the tides of battles turn and the world reveals itself, perhaps there's more than what meets the eye.

With an FM Synth soundtrack and a distinctive visual design, Mecha Ritz: Steel Rondo combines retro aesthetics with modern sensibilities. Along with the simple controls, handcrafted stages and exciting unlockables, you will find yourself coming back for more.

List of Features:

  • Classic Arcade Shoot 'Em Up: Frantic fast paced shooter action.
  • Dynamic Rank System: Self-adjusts to ease in new players or challenge veterans.
  • A Colorful Retro World: Stylized visuals mixing vector graphics and pixel art.
  • Apocalyptic Mechanized Setting: A story of destructive genius and human will.
  • Deep, Satisfying Combat: 15 handcrafted stages with 50 unique bosses.
  • Exciting Unlockables: 14 playable Mechas, branching paths, multiple endings, and more.
  • Original FM Synth Soundtrack: 60 songs to accompany your journey.

Supported languages: English, Japanese


Why Dezatopia & Mecha Ritz is joining the SLG catalog:
Shooters are in the DNA of SLG, be it retro or recent indie efforts. And if we get the opportunity to be able to release such a unique pair of SHMUPs as is the case with Dezatopia & Mecha Ritz, we of course take it. Both feature outstanding graphical styles and refined gameplay, some of the best for vertical and horizontal shooters respectively. And for anyone who wants to delve deeper into the imaginative worlds these two are set in, HEY’s got you covered with extensive archives with journals, artwork and more. It almost doesn’t get better than this. So, we are really happy to have these two join our lineup!


Pre-Order:

Please note: This is a pre-order. You will receive order updates as soon as we receive the games and start shipping.

products.title: Iron Meat - Limited Metal Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
The Iron Meat Limited Metal Edition is an officially licensed, region-free game for Nintendo Switch. This Strictly Limited exclusive is limited to a maximum of 4,000 copies worldwide. All of our games are individually numbered and ship internationally.

LIMITED METAL EDITION INCLUDES:

  • Limited Edition of Iron Meat for Nintendo Switch
  • Reversible Title Sheet featuring the original key visual and a draft of a previous version
  • Full-color Manual with insights on game content, background, and development—40 pages
  • Metal Slipcase suitable for Nintendo Switch game cases
  • Original Metal Soundtrack, including 41 tracks with a duration of approx. 2h33m42s, available to download via a code printed on a flyer


ABOUT THE GAME

Iron Meat is an intense run-and-gun arcade shooter that thrusts players into a chaotic, apocalyptic future where THE MEAT, an all-consuming interdimensional biomass, mutates everything in its path. As Vadim, you'll battle through nine retro-inspired stages, fighting mutated enemies and deadly machines while uncovering the terrifying truth behind secret experiments on the Moon. The gameplay is fast-paced and brutal, combining classic arcade mechanics with intense, bullet-dodging action. Multi-phase boss fights challenge your skills, with difficulty settings that ramp up the intensity for an even tougher experience.

For those who prefer not to face the invasion alone, Iron Meat offers a 2-player couch co-op mode, allowing you to team up with a friend to double the firepower and carnage. As you progress, you'll unlock over 30 skins, each featuring interchangeable parts for endless customization options. Whether you want a shark-headed robot or a half-human, half-dog hybrid, the choice is yours. Get ready to immerse yourself in a gore-ific, high-octane battle against THE MEAT, and put a stop to the horrors unleashed by scientist Yuri Markov's twisted experiments on the Moon. Are you ready to take on the ultimate challenge?

FEATURES:

  • Multi-phase boss fights: Features intense, multi-phase boss battles, paying homage to classic run-and-gun titles.
  • Multiplayer couch co-op: Take on THE MEAT invasion with a friend in 2-player couch co-op.
  • Over 30 unlockable skins: Customize your character with over 30 unlockable skins and interchangeable parts.
  • Brutal Gameplay: Engage in relentless combat across nine stages, combining classic arcade mechanics with intense, bullet-dodging action.


*Customers based in North America can also order this edition through two selected partners, VideoGamesPlus and Shopville. Please note, whilst the total units for this edition will be limited to 4,000 worldwide, serialization will slightly differ: being as usual for anything sold through SLG.com, SLG0001/4000 aso, but with a different serialization though for partners, being VGP001 aso and SV001 aso.

products.title: Wonder Boy Complete Collector's Bundle (NSW)
products.body_html:
Wonder Boy Complete Collector's Bundle contains all of our (to date) three Wonder Boy releases (23 games in total!) in officially licensed Nintendo Switch Collector's Editions. All of the games include a colorful game manual. This bundle is exclusively available at Strictly Limited. All of our games are individually numbered, making them instant collectibles! We ship internationally. Please note that the games included in this bundle are not reprints; they are taken from the first and only print run with original limited quantities communicated. 

 

Wonder Boy Anniversary Collection

There has never been a Wonder Boy collection quite like this!

Featuring 21 versions of six of the most iconic Wonder Boy games ever released, this incredible compilation brings the influential platformer series to today’s hardware. Through the 1980s and 1990s the Wonder Boy series gained a vast cult following thanks to its distinct blend of energetic platforming, action-RPG elements, and even shoot ‘em up gameplay. And now you can enjoy a diverse spread of the Wonder Boy games that have left a powerful legacy throughout gaming, from the 1986 arcade original to 1994’s Monster World IV.

Wonder Boy Anniversary Collection brings the series up-to-date with precise ports for today’s hardware, and new features such as the ability to rewind your game at any moment.

Whether you're a retro devotee wanting to catch up on this important piece of gaming history, a Wonder Boy fan looking to play your favourites on cutting edge hardware or are simply looking to experience the very best in nostalgic gameplay, Wonder Boy Anniversary Collection is about as essential as it gets.

Features:

  • Wonder Boy, Wonder Boy in Monster Land, Wonder Boy III: Monster Lair, Wonder Boy The Dragon‘s Trap, Wonder Boy in Monster World and Monster World IV in a total of 21 ports (see details in table below). 
  • An unrivaled Wonder Boy collection for true retro gamers
  • Every title expertly ported to modern consoles, with extended features like filter, shader, a rewind option and an art gallery!
  • Revisit one of the most unique, important platformers of the 1980s and 1990s
  • Get your nostalgia on with crisp chiptune audio and perfect pixel art


The Collector's Edition contains:

    • Game for Nintendo Switch with colorful Game Manual
    • Collector’s Edition Box with magnetic latch

    • 3 Arcade Flyer
    • Art Card (Shikishi style)

    • Hardcover Artbook
    • Collector’s Coin Album

    • Sticker Set of 7

    • Enamel Pin

Collector's Editions included: 

  • Deathsmiles I・II incl. DLC Gothic wa Mahou Otome 
  • Rolling Gunner + Over Power
  • Abarenbo Tengu & Zombie Nation 

 

Deathsmiles I・II incl. DLC Gothic wa Mahou Otome

The Collector's Edition contains: Limited Edition of the Nintendo Switch Game Deathsmiles I・II in a premium hardcover CE Box with magnetic lock, next to outstanding collectibles such as Wall Scroll with Main Visual, 6 Artwork Postcards, Enamel Logo Pin, Deathsmiles Arcade Flyer, Key Chain Set with Familiar Spirits of the Characters, Acrylic Graveyard DIY-Orama (consisting of 4 Acrylic Standees), Reversible Large Poster DIN A2, Original Soundtrack with Arrange DLC Tracks on CD, Characters and Logo Sticker-Set, 4 Character Cards and 3 Marquee Stickers. 

Deathsmiles is CAVE's bullet-hell shoot-'em-up where you take the role of one of four Angels to defend the magical land of Gilverado from an invasion by Hell itself! Team up with a friend, choose an angel, and eradicate this devilish assault across nine different game modes!

Deathsmiles 2 presents you more of the things that made the first one great, two new characters to play as and a new polygonal graphic style. Chase the evil Satan Claws, who killed your caretaker Count Dior on Christmas Eve, through a hellish winter wonderland!

 

Rolling Gunner + Over Power

The Collector's Edition contains: Limited Edition of the Nintendo Switch Game Rolling Gunner + Over Power in a premium hardcover CE Box with magnetic lock, next to outstanding collectibles such as Art Book, Snow Globe, Original Soundtrack on CD, Sewing Patch, Keychain and large reversible Poster. 

Rolling Gunner and the Over Power DLC all in one edition! Enjoy both the tried-and-true bullet hell experience of the original game and the added features of the twin-stick Over Power mode. You can even compete for high scores online for the very first time.

In Rolling Gunner, you are humanity’s last hope in the defence against the now-sentient computer system BAC that is powering and controlling nearly all of the world’s engines and the planet’s population has been reduced by half. Take flight in the space craft RF-42R STORK which carries the Rolling Gun, a special weapon that was built in secret to fight against BAC in the event of a crisis.

Rolling Gunner is a tough but rewarding bullet hell Shoot ‘em Up where precise play lets you climb the leaderboards. In addition, you can refine your skills in practice mode and save replays to truly analyse and master the game.

 

 

Abarenbo Tengu & Zombie Nation

The Collector's Edition contains: Limited Edition of the Nintendo Switch Game Abarenbo Tengu & Zombie Nation in a premium hardcover CE Box with magnetic lock, next to outstanding collectibles such as Tengu Mask Figurine, 4x Post Cards, Original Soundtrack on CD, large Logo Sticker, Floating Head Cards and large reversible Poster. 

As the disembodied samurai head Namakubi, or in the Japanese version a Tengu, you set out to rescue the world from the alien overlord Darc Seed, who transformed humanity into mindless zombies. On your way you will encounter a variety of bizarre stages and enemies, topped off by the game’s (in)famous boss battles.

In 1991, a game was released for the NES that, while it was already clear would be something special, no one could have imagined would develop into such a cult classic in the years to come. Zombie Nation flew under many people’s radar at the time, but its crazy story and solid gameplay accumulated a dedicated fan base over the years. This new version for Nintendo Switch incorporates new additions, like quality-of -life features such as rewind and quicksave, rapid fire and new HUD elements, as is common with re-releases of classic games. You are also able to choose between the Western version, “Zombie Nation”, and the Japanese version, “Abarenbou Tengu” with two new modes per version. Additionally, there are new achievements and a gallery to unlock. All of this makes this the ultimate version of a beloved classic, now available on a modern console!

G-DARIUS HD and DARIUSBURST Another Chronicle EX+ are the two 3D games of the Darius series, both of which will include updated features to appeal to newcomers and longtime fans of the series alike. 

G-DARIUS HD is the port of "G DARIUS” in high resolution - developed by the emulation specialists at M2. The game can also be played in low resolution like in the original arcade version. 

From the epic boss battles to the memorable soundtrack, G-DARIUS stood out when it first got released in the arcades and up to these days, critics and fans are praising this game as a prime example of how to bring a 2D game series properly to 3D.

DARIUSBURST Another Chronicle EX+ is the latest iteration of the awesome DARIUSBURST series which started in 2009 on PSP, with gorgeous 3D graphics and additional features to expand the arcade version from 2010. The game is developed by Pyramid and will include all features of the arcade version of "Another Chronicle EX", as well as several new elements that will be revealed during the next weeks.

There has never been a Wonder Boy collection quite like this!

Featuring 21 versions of six of the most iconic Wonder Boy games ever released, this incredible compilation brings the influential platformer series to today’s hardware. Enter into a living, playable museum of video game history. A museum that spans across three decades, featuring 19 historically inspired consoles and over 110 levels to conquer. A museum full of sharp things, bad guys and free falls - in which you will die. A lot. Exploring gaming history has never been this fun!

Join a raccoon and a llama in their quest to save video games as we know them! SuperEpic is a Metroidvania style action-adventure game filled with humour and satire. The gameplay is nonlinear and fast-paced, with a large interconnected world to explore and unlock, a responsive customizable action-set for combat and an in-game economy-based upgrading system to fight an invidual entertainment war against the evil RegnantCorp, trying to control minds through abusive micro transactions.

The year is 2084. After a series of mergers, buyouts and hostile takeovers, only one video game development company is left in the world: RegnantCorp. A huge enterprise run by greedy piggies. All the fun in video games has been replaced with intrusive addiction algorithms used to control people’s minds and behaviour. But a rebellion of game enthusiasts is fighting back, replacing RegnantCorp’s software with classic games. Following a distress signal, Tan Tan the raccoon and his valiant llama steed Ola prepare to take on RegnantCorp and confront the pigs...

Making deliveries is never an easy job. But throw in huge and unique destructive tanks you have to battle into the mix? That's life as a new courier for Finneas Fat Cat XV, one of the top tycoons in New Pangea!

Luckily, you'll have a mammoth sized tank of your own when you go out on deliveries. Connect conveyor belts and blast enemy tanks with ammo you craft in the heat of battle. Fund new ammo and gizmos to take down even the most terrifying of tanks! Collect different parts from the tanks you defeat, and you'll be able use those tanks too!
Do you have what it takes to become Finneas Fat Cat's top fixer? And spread his name and wealth even wider? Finneas is counting on you, old bean!

products.title: Super Meta LE Bundle (NSW)
products.body_html:
Super Meta Limited Edition Bundle, contains two officially licensed Nintendo Switch games. All of the games include a colorful game manual. This bundle is exclusively available at Strictly Limited.
All of our games are individually numbered, making them instant collectibles! Please note that the games included in this bundle are not reprints; they are taken from the first and only print run with original limited quantities communicated. 

Games included: 

  • Super Life of Pixel
  • SuperEpic: The Entertainment War

  

Super Life of Pixel

Join Pixel as he quests through gaming history, teleporting across the most iconic video game systems of generations past. Jump, dodge and play smart to survive all the traps, puzzles and enemies waiting at every turn and to unlock the next console on this historic gaming journey. 

Enter into a living, playable museum of video game history. A museum that spans across three decades, featuring 19 historically inspired consoles and over 110 levels to conquer. A museum full of sharp things, bad guys and free falls - in which you will die. A lot. Exploring gaming history has never been this fun!

 

SuperEpic: The Entertainment War

Join a raccoon and a llama in their quest to save videogames as we know them! SuperEpic is a Metroidvania style action-adventure game filled with humour and satire. The gameplay is nonlinear and fast-paced, with a large interconnected world to explore and unlock, a responsive customizable action-set for combat and an in-game economy-based upgrading system to fight an invidual entertainment war against the evil RegnantCorp, trying to control minds through abusive micro transactions.

The year is 2084. After a series of mergers, buyouts and hostile takeovers, only one video game development company is left in the world: RegnantCorp. A huge enterprise run by greedy piggies. All the fun in video games has been replaced with intrusive addiction algorithms used to control people’s minds and behaviour. But a rebellion of game enthusiasts is fighting back, replacing RegnantCorp’s software with classic games. Following a distress signal, Tan Tan the raccoon and his valiant llama steed Ola prepare to take on RegnantCorp and confront the pigs...

The First Tree

From the creator of Home is Where One Starts… comes The First Tree, a third-person exploration game centered around two parallel stories: a fox trying to find her missing family, and a son reconnecting with his father in Alaska. Players take control of the fox on a poignant and beautiful journey that crescendos at the source of life, and perhaps result in an understanding of death. Along the way, players can uncover artifacts and stories from the son's life as he becomes intertwined in the fox’s journey towards The First Tree.


Heaven's Vault

Welcome to the Nebula: a strange network of moons linked by rivers in space, where ancient robots coexist with humans. Its ancient history has long been forgotten and only fragments remain, written in “Ancient”, a lost hieroglyphic language. The search for a missing roboticist sets archaeologist Aliya Elasra and her robot sidekick Six on a trail of discoveries that will lead to the very edge of her world - and the ancient secret of Heaven's Vault. Discover lost sites in an open world, freely explore ancient ruins, decipher an entire hieroglyphic language and dive into a branching story, where every decision matters.

 

7th Sector

Immerse yourself in the intricate path of 7th Sector, where you'll encounter a captivating cyberpunk world. Solve a variety of unique puzzles, navigate through dangers, and uncover scattered information to unravel the compelling story behind this enigmatic universe. Navigate the world's devices and machinery with ease by taking control of multiple characters, each possessing their own unique abilities. products.title: Syder Reloaded - Limited Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Syder Reloaded Limited Edition is an officially licensed Nintendo Switch region-free game. This is a Strictly Limited Games exclusive and comes with a colorful game manual. It is limited to a maximum of 3,000 copies worldwide. All of our games are individually numbered and ship internationally.

Gone are the days of items to upgrade, tedious grinding, and the need for coins to secure continues; your progress is now exclusively measured by your individual skill. If you're in search of a gaming experience that delivers an unadulterated shot of nostalgia coupled with the challenging spirit of the 90s, look no further: Syder Reloaded has got you covered!

Exclusive bonus: Original Soundtrack download code included in every game!

List of Features:

    • 6 Legendary Levels: A challenging Campaign Mode packed with guns, glory, and buckets of adversity for you to overcome!
    • Choose Your Ship: Even more superb starships ready to be commanded, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Choose wisely!
    • How Far Can You Go?: 3 different Survival and Challenge Mode levels, perfect for pilots wishing to showcase their skills.
    • Online Leaderboards: Take control of the all-new scoring system and make your mark on the Global Leaderboards, or go personal and fight for bragging rights at the top of your friends list.
    • Play with What You’ve Got: Pick up a controller or reach for your keyboard, how you play is up to you.
    • Travel Back in Time: Apply a suite of retro graphic filters to change the way you see the game and bring that wonderful hit of nostalgia from the 90s!
    • No Grind, Just Glory: Earn your place among the elite, winning badges and high scores based on skill and ability, not hours invested.
    • Big Bosses Await: Go head-to-head against monstrously-sized ships. Will you overcome these alien invaders?
    • Supports the following languages: English, German, Italian, Spanish

What's New (compared to Syder Arcade):

  • ‘Tis But a Scratch: Introducing grazing! Fly in the face of danger and keep your score multiplier alive by flying close to bullets.
  • Pick Your Poison: Shoot power-ups to cycle through your options. Forget otherwise perfect runs being ruined with random weapon drops. Now you make the call.
  • Make Mine a Multi: Bullet cancelling partially refills the multiplier reset counter. When your special weapon is charged, earn an extra score based on your multiplier.
  • A Fresh Coat of Paint: All new graphics and improved level design, boss battles and enemy behaviors.
  • Expanded Roster: Get ready for battle with 4 new playable ships.
  • Settle The Score: The scoring system has been redesigned from scratch, rewarding the most skilled players.

products.title: Cotton Guardian Force Saturn Tribute Collector's Edition (NSW)
products.body_html:
3 Iconic Shoot 'em Ups from the late 90s'!


Cotton Guardian Force Saturn Tribute Collector's Edition, officially licensed Nintendo Switch game. Includes a color game manual. This edition is exclusively available at Strictly Limited Games, limited to only 750 copies worldwide. All of our games are individually numbered, making them instant collectibles! We ship internationally.

Cotton 2 was originally released in 1997 and was the first game in the series to indroduce Cotton's rival Appli, who is available in two-player mode.
The game diverges from earlier titles in some major ways, like adding a life bar and the ability to pick up enemies and other things and use them to your advantage.

Cotton Boomerang released for Arcades and Saturn on year later and  expanded on some of the changes indroduced in Cotton 2. There are now 8 characters to choose from, including Silk and Needle, Appli's hat. Each character uses a different type of magic and has different shot patterns.
In addition to changes in gameplay, some stage backgrounds have also been redrawn.

Guardian Force rounds out this tribute collection as a Shoot 'em Up known for its mix of innovative gunplay and movement.
While at first glance it seems like the odd one out in this collection, it's part Success' legacy that's lead by the Cotton Series and definitely adds to their tribute to the Saturn.

The Collector's Edition contains:

products.title: Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn Collector's Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Product Overview

Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn Collector's Edition is an officially licensed Nintendo Switch region-free game. This is a Strictly Limited exclusive and comes with a colorful game manual. It is limited to 600 copies worldwide.* All of our games are individually numbered and shipped internationally.

List of Features: 

  • Enjoy the NES classic with stunning modern pixel art, a signature of Tengo Project's visual style.
  • Balancing the charm of the original with modern enhancements, Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn delivers an immersive experience for both dedicated fans and newcomers.
  • Experience upgraded mechanics, including new weapons, tools, and dynamic dash move, offering a fresh take on the platformer.
  • Play solo as Hayate or Kaede, or team up in 2-player mode for cooperative ninja action, maintaining the fast-paced action roots.
  • Navigate through five completely recreated stages with devious traps and challenging platform puzzles. Unveil a sixth entirely new stage for added excitement!
  • Embark on an Epic sound journey with electrifying guitar riffs and fast-paced retro melodies of the star-studded soundtrack by Hiroyuki Iwatsuki and Iku Mizutani!
  • Supports the following audio languages: English, Japanese
    And subtitles: English, Japanese, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Korean, Chinese (simplified) 

Welcome to the year 2029, a dystopian future where two formidable warriors emerge from the shadows to save the nation! After 33 years of anticipation, Tengo Project unveils the legendary action-adventure, Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn, in a new and improved light.

Experience the revival of a classic ninja adventure with Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn. Originally released in 1990 for the NES, this side-scrolling action game is now meticulously remastered after 33 years by the original development team. Despite an average age of 55, the team's passion for game development remains unwavering.

The ninja protagonists, Hayate and Kaede, have undergone a significant visual upgrade, transforming their original 8-bit models into stunning high-quality sprites. Every aspect of this title, from deadly foes to treacherous stages, has been faithfully recreated.

Step into the shadows, wield your katana, and navigate the concrete jungle of the future in this dark action gem, Shadow of the Ninja – Reborn! Combat options are expanded with a variety of weapons and ninja tools, including throwing ninja tools for long-range assaults and powerful close-combat weapons. Engage in battles using ninja swords, chains, a gunpowder gun, cannonball, shurikens, a giant club, a machete, iron caltrops, and healing rice balls.

Recognized as one of the best 2-player co-op experiences of its time, the classic co-op mode makes a return, allowing players to rediscover the joy of playing together. Choose to tackle challenges solo or team up with a friend to face formidable enemies. Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn brings back the excitement of the original game, offering a nostalgic yet refreshing gaming experience.

The remake also features contributions from Iku Mizutani, the star composer behind iconic Natsume sounds and renowned NES game tracks. Retro gaming enthusiasts will revel in Mizutani's guitar riffs and fast-paced melodies!

Collector's Edition highlights: 

  • Limited Edition
    Strictly Limited Edition of the Nintendo Switch game with an exclusive cover design. Game is serialized and includes a colorful 
    Manual
  • Controller Stand
    Store up to two of your controllers in style! Guided by Hayate and Kaede, this acrylic stand keeps holding on to your controllers until you're ready to resume the game. 
  • Original Soundtrack
    Outstanding music by Hiroyuki Iwatsuki and Iku Mizutani including both original and new tracks accompanying this legendary ninja game. 
  • Collector Coin
    Flip a coin in case you're not sure which ninja to select! Metal coin with ninja character designs.
  • Desk Mat
    Japanese-inspired writing mat capturing the ninja warriors Hayate and Kaede. 
  • Sticker Sheet
    Several stickers showing amazing pixel art of game's characters and opponents.
  • Boss & Stage Card Set
    Eight cards including concept art of the main bosses on the front and further information on their respective levels of appearance on the back. 
  • Poster 
    Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn's outstanding Key Visual on a large poster (DIN A2 folded to DIN A5). 

 

* This Collector's Edition of Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn for Nintendo Switch will be limited to a maximum of 600 copies. An additional maximum of 2,400 copies of the game will be allocated for the Limited Edition. This brings the total maximum production to 3,000 games.

products.title: Yu Suzuki: Air Twister - Collector's Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Air Twister Collector's Edition, officially licensed Nintendo Switch game. Includes the game's Limited Edition with a colorful game manual and many additional collectibles. 
Strictly Limited Games exclusive. Limited to a maximum of 500 copies worldwide. All of our games are individually numbered. We ship internationally. 

 What’s Included in the Collector’s Edition:

  • Nintendo Switch Limited Edition of Air Twister
  • Premium Collector’s Box with a magnetic latch
  • 150-Page Art & Guide Book featuring concept art, worldbuilding, and gameplay insights
  • 86-Page Yu Suzuki Bio + Gameography Booklet, covering the iconic creator’s career
  • Air Twister Original Soundtrack composed by Valensia
  • Shikishi-Inspired Artwork Card
  • Yu Suzuki Autograph Card

Take flight with Air Twister - the new all-out rail shooter by legendary arcade developer Yu Suzuki! Assume the role of Princess Arch and help defend her home world, AIR, from the large-scale invasion by Vanguard. Similar to Suzuki’s massively successful Space Harrier series, you will encounter a large array of diverse and creatively designed enemies and challenging bosses. But fear not, your winged mounts and homing missile shooting crossbow won’t fail you. 

Explore various kinds of weaponry power-ups and special moves which you unlock after every run. Or challenge yourself in the numerous other game modes, like Turbo-mode or Boss Rush. 

As you soar through the skies of the various beautifully crafted worlds, you’ll be accompanied by the captivating rock-opera soundtrack composed by the renowned Dutch artist, Valensia. 

    Supported Languages

    English, Arabic, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish.

Tozai will publish the game only in Japan both digitally and physically.

 

COLLECTOR'S EDITION ITEM LIST

  • Limited Edition of the game for Nintendo Switch  
    Irem Collection Volume 3 on cartridge in a game case with an exclusive, limited and serialized cover sheet.
  • Collector's Edition Box

    Faithful reprints of the original flyers.

Game Description 

About Mr. Heli/Battle Chopper

Mr. Heli might be one of the wackiest shoot 'em ups ever released by Irem! 
 
Players take control of the aforementioned Mr. Heli on his journey to save the world. Could it be any other way? However, Mr. Heli has a few tricks up his sleeve in terms of control and design. Gone are the days of merely moving from left to right on the screen. Considered a multidirectional scrolling shoot 'em up, players can control Mr. Heli in a 360° fashion! Uncover hidden paths or gemstones to further upgrade Mr. Heli! 

About Mystic Riders

Considered one of the more obscure Irem games, Mystic Riders ventures into a more fantastical setting rather than the usual dark or Giger-esque Irem style that gamers are familiar with.

You can also fling your broom in a boomerang fashion to block projectiles or get a taste of an early version of the dodge roll, a move that is now common in gaming. The best part? Your friend can join in too, as Mystic Riders supports local two-player co-op! 

Mystic Riders was exclusively released in Japanese arcades, making this the first opportunity for a Western audience to experience this arcade gem in the West and on modern platforms.

Assume the role of King Kayus and his trusty dragon, Bahamoot. Players have separate control over both characters, enabling independent movements and attacks. Bahamooth is invincible and can deflect incoming projectiles with his tail, while Kayus can shoot down approaching enemies with his crossbow. Originally released in 1989 in Japanese arcades, "Dragon Breed's" inclusion in the Irem Collection Volume 3 marks its first console release outside of Japan!

products.body_html:
In celebration of the new Rainbow Cotton iteration, we went ahead to create a handful of amazing Cotton Bundles for your video gaming pleasure! Sorted under gameplay style, platform and era of initial release - this is a convenient way for you to get started on the series OR more easily check up on what games you might have missed out on.

Includes the Limited Editions Editions of the two entries originally released for 16-bit consoles!

Cotton 100% Nintendo Switch

The world has fallen into darkness, and the fairy Silk sets out to look for help. She crosses paths with a young witch called Nata de Cotton, who seems rather uninterested in helping her. That is until Silk tells her that along the way, giant Willows, a candy that Cotton has a massive craving for, are waiting for her along the way, so the two set out to find out what's causing the darkness... or look for Willows!

Cotton 100% was released in 1994 and is based on the original Cotton: Fantastic Night Dreams. It offers a stunning and fresh new look with the more vibrant color palette of the Super Famicom.

Panorama Cotton Nintendo Switch

The game's main character is Nata de Cotton, a witch with unquenchable craving for candy called Willow. She is accompanied by the fairy Silk, who Cotton saved the world with once before. Silk is approached by her sister Knit, who tells her that Queen Velvet has been acting strange. Identifying the source of her behavior as a burnt Willow, Silk tries to dispose of it, but Cotton crosses her path, grabs the Willow and tries to eat it, only to realize that it has been burned. She doesn't care much about the queen or the kingdom, but is angered by the fact that someone is burning Willows, so Cotton and Silk set off to stop whoever is doing such evil things!

In 1994, Panorama Cotton raised the bar for what's possible on the Mega Drive/Genesis consoles. The game's more colorful pallet makes every stage a treat to look at and fly through!

Age Rating

This game has been rated ages 6 and up by the German Entertainment Software Self-Regulation Body (USK). There is no age rating printed or stickered on the box. 

German customers must be at least 18 years old to order and receive the shipment. This does not apply to international customers.

Nata de Cotton Nendoroid

Special Limited Edition Nendoroid of everyone's favorite Willow-addicted witch Nata de Cotton with exchangeable faces and arms, as well as broom and Willow accessories.

Cotton Guardian Force Saturn Tribute Nintendo Switch

3 Iconic Shoot 'em Ups from the late '90s!

Cotton 2 was originally released in 1997 and was the first game in the series to introduce Cotton's rival Appli, who is available in two-player mode.
The game diverges from earlier titles in some major ways, like adding a life bar and the ability to pick up enemies and other things and use them to your advantage.

Cotton Boomerang released for Arcades and Saturn on year later and  expanded on some of the changes introduced in Cotton 2. There are now 8 characters to choose from, including Silk and Needle, Appli's hat. Each character uses a different type of magic and has different shot patterns.
In addition to changes in gameplay, some stage backgrounds have also been redrawn.

Guardian Force rounds out this tribute collection as a Shoot 'em Up known for its mix of innovative gunplay and movement.
While at first glance it seems like the odd one out in this collection, it's part Success' legacy that's lead by the Cotton Series and definitely adds to their tribute to the Saturn.

Game Description


Cotton, the legendary witch is back, and this time in 3D!

Get ready for this formerly Japanese exclusive cute ‘em up gem to be “reconjured”.

ININ and Success have teamed up once again to bring you a massively improved - and for the first time worldwide - re-release of Rainbow Cotton.

Originally released in 2000, Rainbow Cotton takes you on an arcade-inspired journey through 5 enchanting stages: from a cozy moonlit town draped in Christmas lights, through a mysterious sunken forest, all the way to a magical castle above the clouds. Clothed in charming 3D graphics these levels include massive bosses as well as alternative routes to explore, guaranteeing high replay value.

So, collect power-ups to build up your flashy projectiles and hurl them at the colorful enemies. Use powerful magic attacks to clear the screen with fireballs and lighting. Together with some trusty fairies you might stop the evil demon Tweed and help Cotton secure the elusive willow candy for herself.

This already magical experience is enhanced by fully localized anime cutscenes and a graphical overhaul, as well as numerous quality-of-life improvements.

List of Features
  • Dedicated Retro Mode: replicating the original experience as closely as possible.
  • Enhanced controls: Revamped snap-back and lock-on features for a more engaging experience.
  • Full localization, including the anime cutscenes!
  • Graphic enhancements: particle effects, ambient occlusion, and more!

The Collector's Edition contains:

  • Game for Nintendo Switch with reversible cover
  • Premium Collector’s Edition box with magnetic clasp
  • Colorful game manual

products.title: Tiny Thor - Mjölnir Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Product Overview

Tiny Thor Limited Edition is an officially licensed Nintendo Switch region-free game. This is a Strictly Limited Games exclusive and comes with a colorful game manual. It is limited to a maximum of 4,000 copies worldwide. All of our games are individually numbered and shipped internationally.

List of Features: Tiny Thor

  • Master ricocheting hammer throws to overwhelm enemies 
  • Learn awesome special abilities 
  • Explore over 30 handcrafted levels across three distinct realms 
  • Challenging boss fights, each with unique mechanics 
  • Discover tons of secrets and collect hidden gems to unlock challenge levels 
  • Includes a download code for the soundtrack by Chris Hüsbeck
  • Supports the following languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish (Spain), Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified Chinese

List of Features: Hammer Kid 

  • 16-Bit Pixel-Art Platformer 
  • Nostalgic Soundtrack 
  • Use your hammer to defeat enemies 
  • Explore 40 handcrafted levels divided into 4 huge worlds 
  • Discover secrets and collect gems
  • Supports the following languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish (Spain), Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified Chinese

About the Game

Tiny Thor is a love letter to the challenging action platformers of the 16-bit console era, with contributions by two legends of their respective fields. Sporting magnificent pixel art by artist Henk Nieborg to feast your eyes upon and a soundtrack by Chris Hülsbeck, together they help bring home the feeling of playing a classic game with today’s conveniences. 

One area where Tiny Thor doesn’t stray too much from its inspirations is the challenge it provides. The refined gameplay with its focus on using Mjölnir for attack as well as traversal helps to tackle the obstacles head on and rewards you with the ultimate satisfaction when succeeding.  

The version included here features additional gameplay refinements and fixes to make a great game even better. And as a special treat, the wonderful soundtrack by Chris Hülsbeck can be downloaded via Bandcamp to save as you see fit!

Included in this release is also the quasi predecessor of Tiny Thor, Hammer Kid, which goes in a similar direction style wise, also featuring beautiful pixel graphics, but being overall simpler in the gameplay department. Of course, it’s still fun to play through!

products.body_html:
Two legendary adventures in one stellar bundle.
Experience the whimsical charm of Parasol Stars and the cosmic journey of Spica Adventure – together in one action-packed collection.

Parasol Stars

The legendary bubble dragons Bub and Bob are back! In human form! In this classic Taito game, now on modern consoles, Bubby and Bobby use magical parasols to block attacks, stun enemies, and toss them as projectiles while saving neighboring planets.

Spica Adventure

products.title: Irem Collection Volume 2 Collector's Edition (Nintendo Switch)
products.body_html:
Collector's Edition of Irem Collection Volume 2, officially licensed Nintendo Switch game. Includes a colorful game manual and many additional collectibles. 
Strictly Limited Games exclusive. Limited to a maximum of 2,000 copies worldwide. All of our games are individually numbered. We ship internationally. 

 Please note: Strictly Limited Games is releasing this physical edition worldwide exclusively (apart from Japan), there will be no other physical edition of Irem Collection Volume 2 from ININ games, they will just publish the game digitally. Tozai will publish the game only in Japan both digitally and physically.

CE Item list 

  • Limited Edition of the game for Nintendo Switch
    Irem Collection Volume 2 on cartridge in a game case with an exclusive, limited and serialized cover sheet. 
  • Collector's Edition Box 
    An outstanding premium box with magnetic latch in special retro art style to collect the game and all of the collector’s items for this edition. The format will be amended to 4:3 to transfer screen vibes of that time to the box; it will still have same width and height to make sure it looks good in the shelf next to other Strictly Limited Games Collector's Edition.  
    Details: Approx. 28 cm x 21 cm x 4.8 cm, 11” x 8,2” x 1,8”.  
  • Game Manual 
    Colorful manual with game instructions. 
    Details: Included in, and size fitting to the Nintendo Switch game case. 
  • Visual Compendium 
    A compendium comprising a game guide and an art book, which will include all information and profund insights about these three legends of gaming history. Stay tuned for updates on this impressive format!  
    Details: Approx. 28 cm x 21 cm x 4.8 cm. 11” x 8,2” x 1,8” 
  • Original Soundtrack 
    The awesome soundtracks of GunForce, GunForce II, and Air Duel. 
    Details: Soundtrack on CDs in a Jewel Case. 
  • Collector’s Coin 
    Collect the second of five limited irem coins, one for each of the five upcoming volumes of the irem Collection. The arcade-inspired coin design will a.o. include the iconic characters of the games. 
    Details: Approx. 5 cm x 7 cm, 1,9” x 2,7”, 2 g 
  • Marquee Sticker  
    Sticker prints inspired by the original arcade marquees. Together with the retro reprint set, they create an arcade atmosphere at home. 
    Details: Approx. 19.6 cm x 4.2 cm, 7,7” x 1,6”, 2 g 
  • Reversible Poster 
    Featuring the cover of the irem Collection Volume 2 artworks.  
    Details: size approx. 15 cm x 15m, 6" x 6", 5 g 
  • DIY Game Packaging Reproduction 
    Rebuild the GunForce SNES packaging. 
    Details: approx. 14 cm x 9.7 cm x 2.20 cm, 5,5” x 3,8” x 0,8” 
  • Arcade/Game Flyer Reprints 
    Faithful reprints of the original flyers. 
    Details: Several retro flyers and print assets in various sizes. 

    About GunForce 

    GunForce is sometimes considered to be one of the first run 'n' gun games, it can be seen as the initial baby steps that paved the way for the later-released Metal Slug series and its sequel, GunForce II (GeoStorm), both of which were highly acclaimed. GunForce is where it all began, after all! 

    Originally released on the Super Nintendo in the West and in the arcades in Japan, you must run and gun your way through hordes of aliens to stop a rogue CPU and restore freedom to the world. The game shows no mercy and throws you into the enemy frontlines right from the start as you parachute into action. And if that’s not enough '90s action for you, how about doing a wheelie on a motorbike while shooting helicopters? GunForce has got you covered. As it is now a tradition, GunForce introduced different vehicles the player can control – tanks, helicopters or motorbikes. Make your choice! 

    GunForce later received an arcade sequel called GunForce II (GeoStorm), which improved in all aspects. More action, more vehicles - you name it. 

    About GunForce II 

    GunForce II, known as GeoStorm in Japan, is the sequel to the SNES and Arcade game GunForce. It improves upon GunForce in every way and is one of the last arcade games from Irem. GunForce II was never released outside of arcades, making its inclusion in the Irem Collection Vol. 2 its first-ever worldwide console release. 
     

    Featuring improved animations, enhanced gameplay, and a killer soundtrack, GunForce II was created by the same staff that later developed the Metal Slug series. It is considered the spiritual predecessor to the Metal Slug series, with many of its sound effects and designs being reused in the series. It is a must-play for all fans! 
     
    Set in a futuristic post-apocalyptic environment, the game allows you to take control of Max or Lei. Your goal is simple: dual blast your way through 5 different stages and rack up those high scores! Vehicles also return, as it is tradition, including motorbikes, mechs, and tanks, to name a few. 

    About Air Duel 

    The year is 2004. 

    Earth was devastated by an unprecedented nuclear war, and a secret organization called D.A.S. is rising to cause chaos in the world. It is now your job to destroy their mischievous plans and save what remains of the world! 

    Air Duel is a 2D vertically scrolling shoot 'em up that was exclusively available in Japanese arcades and never made it to the West. Its inclusion in the Irem Collection Volume 2 marks its first-ever worldwide console release. Developed by the same legendary team at Irem that brought you GunForce and later the Metal Slug series, Air Duel offers 7 challenging stages that need to be mastered either alone or with a friend in co-op. 

    Choose your aircraft! 

    Whether you want to shoot forward only with the Jet Fighter FG-40 or fire crosswise with the Helicopter E-709, your playstyle is key to victory. 

     

    List of Features 

    • Three timeless classics in one collection 
    • Versions included:
      • GunForce: Arcade (English/Japanese), SNES/Super Famicom 
      • GunForce II: Arcade (English/Japanese) 
      • Air Duel: Arcade (Japanese) 
    • GunForce I and II, two action packed run and guns that served as the basis for the pinnacle of the genre 
    • Gun Force, a hard-as-nails shoot ‘em up that will test your skills 
    • Modern quality of life features like rewind and quick saves 

    Supported Languages: English, Japanese 

     

    Why Irem Collection Volume 2 is joining the SLG catalog 

    Our focus for Volume 2 was to bring back Irem classics that have mostly not been released to Western audiences. In this game, you must run and gun your way through hordes of aliens to stop a rogue CPU and restore freedom to the world. It can be seen as the initial baby steps that paved the way for the later-released Metal Slug series and its sequel, GunForce II (GeoStorm), both of which were highly acclaimed. GunForce is where it all began, after all! 

    On the other hand, GunForce II might not be as renowned to Western audiences as its prequel. Even though it improves upon GunForce in every way and is considered one of the last arcade games from Irem, GunForce II was never released outside of arcades, making its inclusion in the Irem Collection Vol. 2 its first-ever worldwide console release. 

    And last but certainly not least, we have Air Duel, which should delight every classic shoot 'em up fan! Air Duel is a 2D vertically scrolling shoot 'em up that was exclusively available in Japanese arcades and never made it to the West. Seven challenging stages are waiting to be mastered, either alone or with a friend in co-op. 

    Working with the legendary team from Irem to bring back their most beloved IPs in physical form and on modern hardware for everyone to enjoy has always been a dream for us! This dream has now come to fruition once again with the Irem Collection Volume 2.

About GunForce 

GunForce is sometimes considered to be one of the first run 'n' gun games, it can be seen as the initial baby steps that paved the way for the later-released Metal Slug series and its sequel, GunForce II (GeoStorm), both of which were highly acclaimed. GunForce is where it all began, after all! 

Originally released on the Super Nintendo in the West and in the arcades in Japan, you must run and gun your way through hordes of aliens to stop a rogue CPU and restore freedom to the world. The game shows no mercy and throws you into the enemy frontlines right from the start as you parachute into action. And if that’s not enough '90s action for you, how about doing a wheelie on a motorbike while shooting helicopters? GunForce has got you covered. As it is now a tradition, GunForce introduced different vehicles the player can control – tanks, helicopters or motorbikes. Make your choice! 

GunForce later received an arcade sequel called GunForce II (GeoStorm), which improved in all aspects. More action, more vehicles - you name it. 

About GunForce II 

GunForce II, known as GeoStorm in Japan, is the sequel to the SNES and Arcade game GunForce. It improves upon GunForce in every way and is one of the last arcade games from Irem. GunForce II was never released outside of arcades, making its inclusion in the Irem Collection Vol. 2 its first-ever worldwide console release. 
 

Featuring improved animations, enhanced gameplay, and a killer soundtrack, GunForce II was created by the same staff that later developed the Metal Slug series. It is considered the spiritual predecessor to the Metal Slug series, with many of its sound effects and designs being reused in the series. It is a must-play for all fans! 
 
Set in a futuristic post-apocalyptic environment, the game allows you to take control of Max or Lei. Your goal is simple: dual blast your way through 5 different stages and rack up those high scores! Vehicles also return, as it is tradition, including motorbikes, mechs, and tanks, to name a few. 

About Air Duel 

The year is 2004. 

Earth was devastated by an unprecedented nuclear war, and a secret organization called D.A.S. is rising to cause chaos in the world. It is now your job to destroy their mischievous plans and save what remains of the world! 

Air Duel is a 2D vertically scrolling shoot 'em up that was exclusively available in Japanese arcades and never made it to the West. Its inclusion in the Irem Collection Volume 2 marks its first-ever worldwide console release. Developed by the same legendary team at Irem that brought you GunForce and later the Metal Slug series, Air Duel offers 7 challenging stages that need to be mastered either alone or with a friend in co-op. 

Choose your aircraft! 

Whether you want to shoot forward only with the Jet Fighter FG-40 or fire crosswise with the Helicopter E-709, your playstyle is key to victory.

ABOUT AKAI ITO

"Akai Ito" is a captivating visual novel originally released on PlayStation 2 in Japan, that takes players on an emotional journey of love, mystery, and self-discovery originally. Set in modern-day Japan, the story follows the protagonist, Kei, as she navigates the complexities of her past and uncovers the truth about her identity. 
After the untimely passing of her mother, Kei inherits an old Japanese mansion in the secluded town of Hemizuka. Intrigued by the mysteries surrounding her family and the legend of the mountain god, Kei embarks on a quest to uncover the secrets hidden within her ancestral home. Along the way, Kei encounters Yumei, a girl with a connection to the mystical world, and together they delve deeper into the enigma that binds them. 
Featuring beautiful artwork, evocative music, and multiple branching storylines, "Akai Ito" offers a rich visual and narrative experience. The choices made by players will shape Kei's journey, leading to different outcomes and endings that reflect the complexities of love, sacrifice, and personal growth. 

 

ABOUT AOI SHIRO

"Aoi Shiro" originally released on the PlayStation 2 in Japan, is an enchanting visual novel that transports players to the picturesque town of Kakyouin. 

As the protagonist, a young detective named Kurohime, players embark on a journey to unravel the secrets of Kakyouin. The town is known for its unique folklore and legends, including the enigmatic tale of the "Aoi Shiro" or "Blue Castle." Kurohime's investigation delves into the ancient rituals, hidden powers, and the intricate relationships that shape the destiny of Kakyouin. 

As the story unfolds, players must make choices that not only affect Kurohime's personal journey but also determine the fates of the townspeople and the ultimate truth behind the mysteries of Kakyouin. Multiple branching paths and endings add depth and replayability to the narrative, ensuring that each playthrough offers a unique experience. 

 

FEATURES

  • Includes two games, plus the bonus game Onigiri no Oni
  • Captivating romantic narratives filled with love and intrigue. 
  • Stunning high-definition visuals that bring the vibrant worlds to life. 
  • Diverse and engaging characters with compelling backstories. 
  • Branching narratives with multiple paths and endings. 
  • Immersive soundtracks that enhance the emotional impact. 
  • Seamless blend of visual novel storytelling and interactive gameplay. 
  • Rich cultural settings inspired by Japanese folklore and traditions. 
  • Intuitive user interface for a smooth and immersive experience. 
  • Emotionally charged moments that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 
  • Endless replayability with hidden secrets to uncover. 

 

LANGUAGES 

  • English
  • Japanese

 

WHY AKAI ITO & AOI SHIRO HD REMASTER IS JOINING THE SLG CATALOG

Akai Ito & Aoi Shiro HD Remaster is joining the Strictly Limited Games Family in one spectacular collection! 

Calling all Visual Novel fans! It's time to rejoice because Akai Ito & Aoi Shiro are finally making their way to Visual Novel enthusiasts worldwide. We firmly believe that they are a perfect fit for our SLG Family, especially considering their original Japan-exclusive debut on the PlayStation 2 in 2004 and 2008. As a result, these captivating titles were never released in the West, making them an absolute must-have for visual novel fans eagerly awaiting thrilling new stories. Strictly Limited Games will bring the titles to the Nintendo Switch, complete with English subtitles, all in one package. 

Akai Ito & Aoi Shiro can be considered milestones of their genre in Japan. Their unique ways of storytelling combine romantic moments and horrifying situations, creating a remarkable atmosphere for players worldwide. Furthermore, the exceptional performances by the talented voice actors, who have breathed life into the characters and infused them with depth and emotion, enhance the immersive and captivating journey of these amazing narratives. Another standout is the original soundtrack, which perfectly captures the vibes of both games and gracefully accompanies the story and characters.

GAME DESCRIPTION

Image Fight, Image Fight 2, and X Multiply are three classic Shoot 'Em Up games that have captivated gamers for decades. These games were originally released in the late 1980s and early 1990s, during the golden age of arcade gaming, and have since become cult classics among retro gaming enthusiasts.

Image Fight, released in 1988, was the first game in the series and set the standard for the rest of the franchise. The game was known for its challenging gameplay and impressive graphics, which were considered cutting-edge for their time. Players take on the role of a pilot fighting against a group of alien invaders and have to navigate through a series of increasingly difficult levels.

Image Fight 2, released in 1992, expanded on the gameplay of the original game and added new features. The game also boasted improved graphics and sound effects, making it an even more immersive and engaging experience. With the animations before and during the stages, this game creates a thrilling experience of playing the hero of an anime series.

X Multiply, released in 1989, was a spin-off of the Image Fight series and took the gameplay in a slightly different direction. The game is set in a biological world, and players must navigate through a parasite-infected human body filled with organic enemies and obstacles. X Multiply was known for its unique setting, challenging gameplay, and powerful graphics, which were among the best on the arcade platform at the time.

Overall, the Image Fight series and X Multiply are classic examples of the Shoot 'Em Up genre, and are beloved by gamers who appreciate challenging gameplay, imposing graphics, and timeless classics. Whether you're a fan of retro gaming or just looking for a new challenge, these games are sure to provide hours of entertainment and excitement.



FEATURES 

Image Fight

  • You can adjust the speed of your machine in four stages.
  • Use the backfire of your engine to deal damage, making it one of the most important weapons for strategy
  • Collect pods to raise your firepower, but beware! Pods do not block enemy bullets!
  • Nine different types of parts to equip and upgrade your machine, like Barrier, Vulcan 7 and Ring laser


Image Fight 2

  • Builds on the gameplay foundation of Image Fight
  • Seven new types of equipment parts compared to the predecessor, like Plasma flame, Gravity Bomb and Wipe laser
  • Voiced anime sequences between stages


X Multiply

  • Collect power-ups to grow your tentacles to shoot and protect your machine.
  • Defeat the alien parasite in a horrific environment.
